data.name: Eerie Night - Escape from the Funfair - Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
You were just hoping to have a good time at the fair before it closes its doors for good. But a ride with the ghost train takes you to an eerie parallel world where nothing is what it seems.

Find your way out in time, before you lose yourself in this world forever! Free mysterious beings who will support you on your journey with their abilities. Solve tricky puzzles and discover long-forgotten artifacts in dark hidden-object scenes. Are you ready to unravel the darkness and fill the place with light and joy once more? Your adventure begins now!

Here's what awaits you:

- An exciting story set in a spooky funfair

- Mysterious locations, such as the magician's enchanted tent or the room of illusions

- Tricky tasks and puzzles

- Different types of hidden object scenes

- Challenging mini-games

The Collector's Edition offers you another thrilling story! This time, you find yourself in the restricted area of the haunted house, where you come across an unusual room. Once the door closes behind you, there's no way out except to solve the puzzles this spooky place has to offer.

Expect additionally:

- Another adventure, this time in escape room style

- Several fantastic rooms with wondrous puzzles

- More hidden object scenes

- More mini-games

- Artwork, backstory, and wallpapers

- Sit back, relax, and replay all the hidden object scenes and mini-games
